name: Eagan Peltskinner
summary: Outside Northshire Abbey, Eagan Peltskinner has work for recruits as timber wolves threaten the valley. The local furrier needs hunters to thin the packs and bring back pelts.

sections.title: A Word with the Furrier
sections.body: Deputy Willem often sends recruits from the abbey to find Eagan Peltskinner, who works nearby on its grounds. Northshire Valley's orchards and fields lie beside wild woods where timber wolves prowl. Eagan wants newcomers to hunt the aggressive packs and gather pelts for his craft.

sections.title: Trouble on the Perimeter
sections.body: Timber wolves threaten workers, acolytes, and supplies moving in and out of Northshire. Sending young champions to Eagan helps keep nearby paths safe while sparing Stormwind's few remaining guards. They are already occupied by rising tensions across Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Eagan Peltskinner?
faq.answer: Deputy Willem, outside Northshire Abbey's entrance, directs promising recruits to Eagan after introducing the valley's security concerns.
Eagan Peltskinner works near Northshire Abbey's outer walls, around the left side of the main building, among his drying racks and gear.

faq.q: What does Eagan Peltskinner need help with?
faq.answer: Eagan needs a hunter to kill the aggressive timber wolves in the surrounding woods and bring back their pelts, clearing Northshire's perimeter.

faq.q: Can you skip this quest and talk to Eagan directly?
faq.answer: Yes. Eagan offers his hunting work directly to anyone who approaches him. Speaking with him first simply means you miss Deputy Willem's introduction.

faq.q: Why are there so many wolves in Northshire Valley?
faq.answer: Northshire Valley borders dense, untamed woodlands where timber wolves roam freely. Local guards are stretched thin by other threats across the kingdom, leaving the predators unchecked.

faq.q: What task follows speaking with Eagan Peltskinner?
faq.answer: After you speak with Eagan, he asks you to hunt timber wolves beyond the abbey grounds and collect their tough pelts.

angles.text: Every small task in Northshire helps secure Stormwind's home territory while the kingdom's core army remains stretched thin elsewhere.
As a young human leaving Northshire Abbey, helping local tradesfolk like Eagan is your first lesson in defending your homeland.
